response.text:
Invoice 465 is paid (status P, journal 1746), so it is the copy to keep. Invoice 801 is open (status O, journal 2458) and is the duplicate, so I void it and reverse every line of journal 2458.

The original journal 2458 posted Dr 5100 12185.45 / Cr 2000 12185.45 in period 9, which is closed. The reversal has to go into an open period, so I use period 11, the earliest open one. The reversal is Dr 2000 12185.45 / Cr 5100 12185.45.

arguments.reasoning: Invoice 801 duplicates invoice 465 (same vendor, invoice number differing only by a trailing space, same amount and date). Invoice 465 is paid, so it is kept. Invoice 801 is open and is voided. Its journal 2458 (Dr 5100 / Cr 2000, 12185.45) is reversed line by line in open period 11, because period 9 is closed. The reversal is Dr 2000 / Cr 5100 for 12185.45.
